# Folio by Zip1

Folio is the web search page at https://www.zip1.ai/. A query can include web results, and Wikipedia and Grokipedia when those sources are switched on.

- [Search](https://www.zip1.ai/): the search box
- [About](https://www.zip1.ai/about): what Folio by Zip1 is
- [How to search](https://www.zip1.ai/how-to-search): the search box, source switches, results, and page controls

Addresses that contain a search query are the same search page, not separate articles.

Bot search is `GET https://www.zip1.ai/api/search`. `q` is required and limited to 180 characters. `web`, `wiki`, `grok`, and `ai` are `1` or `0` and default to `1`. `images`, `chatgpt`, and `claude` are `1` or `0` and default to `0`. `webPage`, `wikiPage`, `grokPage`, and `imagesPage` start at 1. Web returns up to 10 results, Wikipedia 8, Grokipedia 12, and Images 24 (up to 10 pages; each image result adds `image`, `thumbnail`, and, when known, `width` and `height`). On the first page, unless `ai` is `0`, the JSON includes `ai` (`text` and `sources`) or `aiError`. The note is written from the website passages. Wikipedia and Grokipedia are used only when the web list has no usable passage. When `chatgpt` or `claude` is `1` on that first page, the JSON includes that note or its error. Neither is a result list. The search does not run when `web`, `wiki`, `grok`, and `images` are all `0`.
